commit.message:
check for data races in more packages (#38749)

* adding packages to the race check

* stacks: fix a race condition by replacing a bool with an atomic.Bool

AnnounceDiagnostics can be called by stackeval.PlanAll from multiple goroutines, so I replaced the single boolean `errored` with an atomic.

* fix test-only race condition
